annotations.title: Create or update an API endpoint

description: Document an endpoint: creates it, or updates the existing one for the same method + path. Use it whenever you add or change a route in the code, so the docs stay true. Only the fields you send change. `path` may use :id, {id} or {{id}} for variables. `folder` is created by name if missing. Send `version` (from get_api_endpoint) to avoid overwriting a teammate's edit; a stale version is rejected.

body.description: Example request body (any JSON). null clears it.

kind.description: `event` for a webhook your app sends.

name.description: Short title, e.g. Create a charge. Defaults to METHOD /path.

name: upsert_api_endpoint
